Commentary.Commentary: That comes as surprise! ENGLAND HAVE DECLARED! Pakistan have been set a target of 343 and their openers now come out to the middle. They have around 4 sessions, to score these. What a bold move by England. Will it come off? We will find out. It is Ollie Robinson who now has the new ball in hand. Here we go...

What an entertaining session! Have to say England are in a very strong position courtesy the Root-Brook stand. They have stretched their lead to close to 350 and are not yet done. They lost Zak Crawley early but then Root and Brook played brilliantly. There were hardly any dots and they were managing to find boundaries at will. The added almost 100 in no time with both scoring half tons. Stokes and Root fell in quick succession but Jacks then came out and did not let the momentum slip away. He too fell though but England continued to play their shots. Right at the stroke of Tea though, Brook saw his middle stump being castled. We expect England to aim something near the 400-run mark before declaring. Their approach won't change after the break and all Pakistan will be hoping to do is take wickets. This game is well and truly on and a result seems highly likely now. Stay tuned for what could be another brilliant session.

OUT! TIMBER! No consecutive tons for Brook but yet another wonderful innings from him and a debut to remember. Maybe he could have played his way to his ton but that shot just shows, it is team first for him. On middle, he looks to heave it across the line but misses it altogether. The stumps are shattered. Brook walks back and so do the umpires and the players as THAT IS TEA ON DAY 4!
Short and on middle, Liam looks to pull, he gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side. A run taken.
Shorter and around off, this is guided through point for one.
Another swing and a miss! Angled into the pads. Liam swings, he misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
A slower one on middle, Brook looks to heave it on the leg side but it goes off the inner half towards deep square leg for one.
Another swing and a miss! A slower one outside off. Liam swings but misses.
NO BALL! Well wide outside off, it lands outside the pitch. Left alone. No ball given.
A single! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A slower one outside off, Harry Brook looks to play the paddle scoop but misses.

On off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Nailed! Jacks now plays the reverse sweep, this is on middle, it is races to the cover fence.
Around off, this is guided towards point for one.
Shorter and outside off, Brook looks to cut but is beaten.
FOUR! Smashed again! This is full and on middle, Brook steps out and slams it down the ground to the long off fence.
The sweep again but it goes towards deep square leg for one.
FOUR! That is brilliant! Even Rizwan liked it! Brook steps out, Zahid fires it down the leg side. Brook manages to sweep it past short fine leg for a boundary. Really good.
On middle, blocked.
SIX! Right in the arc and out of the park! This is given a lot of air and it is very full. It is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.

That was quite slow from Brook! Not sure what he was thinking about. He steps out but does not get to the pitch of it. Defends it and then stands his ground. Rizwan is quick to the ball and looks to back flick it onto the stumps. Brook realises and looks to make it back in. Rizwan misses his shy.
This lands around leg and spins away, Brook looks to defend but it goes off the outer half to point.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is pushed towards long on for one.
Another single as Jacks sweeps it through square leg.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
The paddle scoop, it it goes towards fine leg for one.
A loud shout but turned down! This lands on off and spins back in. Jacks looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Going down leg.
Fifty for Brook! What a debut he is having! A 150 followed by a half ton and he is not done yet! Gets there by working it through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, kept out.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

OUT! TAKEN! Really not sure what Stokes was trying to do there! It all looked ugly in the end! This is slower and it lands around off and it is turning back in. Stokes looks to hit it through covers. The length and line was not the right one to play that shot. This takes the top edge as Stokes fails to get on top of the bounce and lobs upto cover where Saud takes it. Two in quick succession for Zahid and Pakistan.
Commentary.Howout: c Saud Shakeel b Zahid Mahmood

Commentary.Commentary: Out comes the reverse sweep but Stokes finds point.
On middle, kept out. Stokes wants a sighter.

It goes off the top edge and Imam-ul-Haq takes an easy catch at short fine leg. A good innings from Root comes to an end. England effectively 270 for 4.

FOUR! There is a run at least of almost every ball. Outstanding from England. Now the sweep from Brook and he naisl it through square leg. Boundary.
FOUR! Brook steps out, makes it into a full toss and hits it past the bowler for a boundary.
This is swept through square leg for one.

Down the leg side, Brook looks to flick but misses.

On middle, blocked.

On middle, defended.
FOUR! The reverse sweep and this time he gets the desired result! A full toss on the pads, Root plays the reverse sweep down to the third man fence.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
DROPPED! Not an easy chance though! Root plays the switch hit. He drags it from outside leg and towards cover. The fielder dives to his left, gets two hands to it but can't hang on. A run taken.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, defended.
Angled into the pads, Brook works it to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed wide of mid off for one.
FOUR! Fuller and on middle, Root shows the full face of the bat and creams it down to the long off fence.
On off, kept out.
On off, kept out.
Three! On middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket. Three taken.
A single for Brook as he pushes it through covers.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Lands just short! Slows it up, lands it around off, this pitches and turns away. Root looks to defend, it goes off the outside edge but lands short of the first slip fielder.
Shortish and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot! Steps out, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On off, defended well.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
Fuller and on middle, Brook drives it to the left of mid on. The fielder runs, dives and keeps it down to one.

On off, defended.

On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.

Around off, Root guides it to point.

On middle, defended.

On middle, defended.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to the left of mid off for one.

Around off, defended.
On off, kept out.

A LOUD APPEAL FOR CAUGHT BUT TURNED DOWN! Rizwan wants it to be reviewed and it is. Crawley indicates it has hit his shoulder. OUT! There is a spike on Ultra Edge as it passes the glove and the on-field call has to be overturned! Not sure why Crawley was rubbing his shoulder as that was nowhere near the shoulder. He falls shortly after getting to his half ton. Down the leg side, short. Crawley looks to pull, this seems to have taken the glove and Rizwan takes it. A successful review from Pakistan and a much-needed wicket as this stand was taking the game away from them.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Mohammad Ali

We are back for the second session. Root and Crawley will resume their innings.
... DAY 4, SESSION 2 ...

Earlier, England started the day with the hopes of getting a lead of over 100 but Agha Salman counter-attacked and got up a half ton. He along with the tail got the trail below 100 before Jacks got all three wickets to fall today. England now will hope the two batters out there can put up a good stand. They will continue to play attacking cricket which will also give Pakistan a chance to take a wicket. We are in for some entertainment after the break. Do join us in a bit.

End of an action-packed mini session here! England continue to score freely but Pakistan will be pleased with the two wickets they have got. However, it is England who are in a good position in this game as they have stretched their lead to over 120 and still have 8 wickets in hand. The start though was not the best as they lost Duckett on the second ball itself. Pope and Crawley then counter-attacked but that stand was cut short and Pope was bounced out. Root and Zak then ensured there were no more wickets to fall before the break.
A single to end the session then! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 4!
On off, blocked.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.

Just over the fielder! A brilliant dipping slower ball, it is a full toss but a dipping one. Zak Crawley was completely done in by the lack of pace. He ends up chipping it but over the leaping fielder at mid off for two.

On off, defended.

Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Back of a length and on off, this is guided past point for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Pope has been bounced out and Pakistan have another one. England are effectively 114 for 2. A short one and on middle, Pope goes for the pull, he fails to get on top of the bounce, it goes off the top edge towards fine leg and it is taken easily by Shah. Another centurion from the first innings walks back for a low score. Can Pakistan get another one before the break?
Commentary.Howout: c Naseem Shah b Mohammad Ali

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! That needed to stick! A tough chance! On middle, Zak Crawley looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It goes off the leading edge to the left of Shah. He dives and looks to take it with one hand but the ball does not stay in. Good attempt.

Good length and on middle, Crawley plays it to mid on.

On off, defended.
Angled into the pads, Pope looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A run taken. Leg bye.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Pakistan strike on the second ball! A ton for Ben Duckett in the first innings and a duck in the second. Not a shot he will be proud of. He could have left that alone. This is on a length and outside off, Duckett goes after it, this goes off the outside edge to second slip and it is taken Agha Salman. That is the perfect start for the hosts.
Commentary.Howout: c Agha Salman b Naseem Shah
